notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.content:
Thank you Data Conversion Operators for your valuable bug reports, feedback, and reviews.

[b]Here's what's new in v1.6:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where if you Saved and Quit with a very specific timing (right after starting your workday at the computer), if you then- from the Titlescreen- immediately loaded the Save it would put the game into such a w e i r d and cursed state that it even freaked ME out with how suddenly foreign and unreliable certain things now became... somehow while still kinda 'functioning'? As fun as this was though, it could easily soft lock the game (and possibly kill your playthrough)
[*] Patched a bug where you could possibly phase through the locked fence in the stairwell, and your reward was prematurely being locked away forever in a dark descending abyss
[*] Fixing an annoying bug where if you exited the Pause screen while standing in front of something interactable, it would be interacted with
[*] Fixed some unintended lighting oddities that could occur in the apartment
[*] Fixed an edge case bug where key in the Key Rebinding screen in Settings could eventually forget its default bindings if you reset it with the Backspace key several times, whoops
[*]Fixed misc UI timing bugs 
[*] Key Rebinding screen will now alert you if you've bound the same key to multiple actions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.5 [Linux Users Please Read]
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Hot fixing a [b]critical issue[/b] preventing native Linux build from launching correctly if you have updated glibc to v2.41 (which apparently broke a lot of backwards compatibility, and fun fact was released the same day as DEAD LETTER DEPT.) [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1627350/discussions/1/600770015625540643/]Steam Forum thread about it here.[/url]
[*] Cloud syncing on Linux should now fully function correctly
[*] Fixing a rare edgecase issue where entering a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tab_key#Tab_characters]Vertical Tab[/url] (somehow) in a very very specific circumstance could somehow cause the save data to get corrupted and ultimately reset itself. Also, I learned that Vertical Tabs are apparently a thing, but how you enter one in 2025 is a complete mystery to me (chime in if you're familiar with using these in the modern age).
[*] Adding an error screen on launch to notify you if the Save Data is corrupted/not loadable, which will give you some options to consider. Mainly added this to catch any other weird circumstances after encountering the crazy Vertical Tab thing. If I'm very lucky nobody will ever see it.
[*] Fixing the Recommended Controller layout for SteamDeck not showing up correctly
[*] Fixing minor bug where the Display Resolution setting would get confused and show the wrong entry
[*] Several other minor polish & fixes
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]I'm happy to announce that the demo for [b]𝐃𝐄𝐀𝐃 𝐋𝐄𝐓𝐓𝐄𝐑 𝐃𝐄𝐏𝐓. is now available to check out on Steam for PC![/b][/h3]


The demo is an [b]updated version[/b] of the early demo released via the Haunted PS1 Demo Disc: Spectral Mall compilation. It contains:
[list]
[*] New content
[*] Key rebinding
[*] Bug fixes to some particularly weird situations
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520437/c4882aadd9c12bf73fa7fb290eaa2cf48c02b9ed.jpg[/img]
[h2]Incidentally it will also be participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] next week, October (3rd-10th)[/h2] 
Next Fest, if you're unaware, is now a sort of [b]heavily ranked[/b] sort of situation to get to the top of the list (or at least to not be buried 200 clicks deep), [b]so please tell a friend or 5 you think would be interested in 𝐃𝐄𝐀𝐃 𝐋𝐄𝐓𝐓𝐄𝐑 𝐃𝐄𝐏𝐓.[/b] during Next Fest, and help keep it out of sinking into the pit.

[h3]Additionally [b]if you have any feedback[/b][/h3] (love or hate, give it here), I want to know it. Feel free to post it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1627350/discussions/0/]Steam forums[/url] or you can use this [url=https://forms.gle/T6AJNdnT62ryj5sJ7]private survey form[/url] and unload it there.
